title: 3d gizmo doesn't update, collisionpolygon3d inspector change
body:
### Tested versions

Reproducible in:
v4.7.1.rc1.official [17e2686e0]
v4.7.stable.official [5b4e0cb0f]
v4.6.3.stable.official [7d41c59c4]

### System information

Godot v4.7.1.rc1 - Windows 11 (build 26100) - Multi-window, 1 monitor - OpenGL 3 (Compatibility) - GeForce GTX 550 Ti - Intel(R) Core(TM) i3-2100 CPU @ 3.10GHz (4 threads) - 11.95 GiB memory - WASAPI (48000 Hz, Stereo/mono)

### Issue description

The 3d gizmo doesn't update, when a collisionpolygon3d's polygon is changed in the inspector.

### Steps to reproduce

- open the project: [3d-gizmo-doesn't-update-collisionpolygon-3d-inspector-change.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/29673075/3d-gizmo-doesn.t-update-collisionpolygon-3d-inspector-change.zip)
- in the scene panel, select: CollisionPolygon3D
- in the inspector, unfold the Polygon, PackedVector2Array
- increase the first point's y value, either by typing a new value: 1.0 or drag right on the value

Issue:
The 3d gizmo handle on the top left point doesn't move, even though the collision polygon's vertex moved.

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/498f6ea6-89b3-4c46-9ee5-4700748ef1a1

Expected:
Update the 3d gizmo's handle to follow the vertex.


Notes:
The 3d gizmo's handle updates when:
- clicking on another 3d gizmo handle
- clicking or dragging on the moved CollisionPolygon3D vertex without a 3d gizmo handle
- clicking on the CollisionPolygon3D in the viewport
- deselecting and selecting the CollisionPolygon3D

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

[3d-gizmo-doesn't-update-collisionpolygon-3d-inspector-change.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/29673075/3d-gizmo-doesn.t-update-collisionpolygon-3d-inspector-change.zip)
